sys_atf_test.description:
Pre-conditions: - create a new department - create a HR position that uses the newly created department - create a second position that Report to the first position
4. Manager then adds appropriate HIRA Records (stored in a custom table). When complete, the Manager clicks "Send to OHS" a. Assignment Group = CEH-HRS-OHS-Advisor b. State = Final Review – Advisor c. Notification sent to Manager: HOC – OHSM Manager – HIRA Assigned
5. An advisor reviews and can return it to the Manager (Send to Manager) with comments or accept the HIRA (Complete Review). 1. If returned to Manager 1. Assigned To = Manager 2. State = In Progress 3. HIRA State = stays the same 4. Notification sent to Manager: HOC – OHSM Manager – HIRA Assigned
